q22812.en: As a rule, vehicles must drive on the right-hand side of the carriageway and close to the right edge.

explain.short: In Italy traffic keeps to the right. Driving near the right edge leaves room for oncoming and overtaking vehicles.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) is correct here: there are exceptions, like overtaking or turning left.

sceneParams.caption: Keep right, near the right edge
lines: Two-way road: keep to the right side

q22813.en: On a road divided into two separate carriageways as in the picture, vehicles must, as a rule, drive on the carriageway on the right with respect to their direction of travel.

explain.short: With two separate carriageways, each one is for one direction. You use the one on your right, like on a motorway.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'carreggiata di destra' is right: the left carriageway is for traffic coming the other way.

sceneParams.caption: Two carriageways: use the one on your right
lines: Use the right one for your direction

q22814.en: On a road divided into three separate carriageways as in the picture, vehicles must, as a rule, drive on the central carriageway or on the one on the right with respect to their direction of travel.

explain.short: With three carriageways, the left one is for traffic in the other direction. You may use the central one or the one on your right.
explain.rule: With three separate carriageways you use the central one or the one on your right, never the one on your left.
explain.trap: 'centrale o quella di destra' (central or right): both are allowed, only the left one is not.

sceneParams.caption: Three carriageways: central or right one
lines: Use the central or the right one
Never the one on your left

q22815.en: On a two-way carriageway with two lanes, as in the picture, vehicles must drive in the right lane, using the left one only for overtaking.

explain.short: On a road with one lane each way, the left lane belongs to oncoming traffic. You enter it only for a short time to overtake.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'solo quella di sinistra per il sorpasso' is correct: the left lane is only for overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: One lane each way: keep right, left only to overtake

q22816.en: On carriageways with three lanes per direction, as in the picture, motor vehicles must, as a rule, use the freest lane on the right.

explain.short: With several lanes in your direction, you use the free lane that is furthest to the right. The lanes on the left are for overtaking.
explain.rule: On roads with two or more lanes per direction, use the freest lane on the right; the left lanes are for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'più libera a destra' means the free lane furthest right, not any lane you like.

sceneParams.caption: Use the freest lane on the right
lines: Use the free lane most to the right

keywords.it: tre corsie per senso di marcia

q22817.en: Motor vehicles may drive in parallel rows close to junctions regulated by traffic officers or by traffic lights.

explain.short: Near a junction with traffic lights or a police officer, queues form in every lane. So driving side by side in parallel rows is allowed there.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'regolati da vigili o da semafori' is the key: at junctions WITHOUT lights or officers it is not allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Junction with lights or police: side by side OK
lines: Cars queue side by side in lanes

q22818.en: On a two-way road with three lanes, as in the picture, vehicles may use the central lane for normal driving.

explain.short: On a two-way road with three lanes, the central lane is shared by both directions. It is only for overtaking and turning left, not for normal driving.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with three lanes, drive in the right lane; the central lane is only for overtaking and for turning left.
explain.trap: 'marcia normale' (normal driving) is the trap: the central lane is never for normal driving.

sceneParams.caption: Centre lane (B): only to overtake or turn left
lines: Centre lane: overtake or turn left

q22819.en: When a road is two-way with three lanes, as in the picture, vehicles may drive in parallel rows.

explain.short: Here each direction has only one real lane; the centre lane is shared. So there is no room to drive side by side.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'doppio senso ... tre corsie': three lanes for TWO directions is not enough for parallel rows.

sceneParams.caption: Two-way, three lanes: no parallel rows
lines: Only one lane is really yours

q22820.en: To turn left, vehicles must keep to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: To turn left you move towards the centre line, not to the right edge. Turning left from the right edge would cut across everyone.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' is wrong for a LEFT turn: the right edge is for right turns.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: move to the centre line, not the right edge
lines: Move close to the centre line

q22821.en: It is possible to drive in the centre of the carriageway when the road is clear.

explain.short: You must always keep to the right, even on an empty road. Someone can appear suddenly from a bend, a hump or a side road.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'quando la strada è libera' (when the road is clear) does not change the rule: keep right anyway.

sceneParams.caption: Empty road? Still keep right
lines: Empty road, no cars in sight
Do not drive in the centre

keywords.en: in the centre of the carriageway

q22822.en: On a two-way road with two lanes, as in the picture, vehicles may drive in parallel rows.

explain.short: This road has only one lane for each direction. Two cars side by side would occupy the lane of oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'due corsie' here means one per direction: parallel rows need two lanes in YOUR direction.

sceneParams.caption: One lane each way: no parallel rows
lines: No room to drive side by side

q22823.en: In heavy traffic it is allowed to drive in parallel rows, using the lanes reserved for buses and public service vehicles.

explain.short: Heavy traffic allows parallel rows only in normal lanes. Bus lanes stay reserved for buses and taxis.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'utilizzando le corsie riservate' is the trap: reserved lanes are never added to the parallel rows.

sceneParams.caption: Bus lane stays for buses, even in heavy traffic
lines: Heavy traffic in the normal lanes
Bus lane is reserved for buses
Do not use it for your row

q22824.en: Vehicles without an engine must drive as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: Bicycles, carts and other vehicles without an engine are slow. Staying at the right edge lets faster traffic pass safely.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'il più possibile vicino' (as close as possible) is correct for slow vehicles without an engine.

sceneParams.caption: Bikes and carts: tight to the right edge
lines: They keep tight to the right edge
Faster cars pass on the left

q22825.en: Whoever leads animals must keep them as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: Animals on the road are slow and unpredictable. Keeping them at the right edge leaves the rest of the road to vehicles.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'il più possibile vicino al margine destro' is right: animals also keep to the right.

sceneParams.caption: Animals on the road: keep them at the right edge
lines: Person leading animals on the road
Keep them tight to the right edge
Cars pass slowly on the left

q22826.en: On two-way roads with two lanes, as in the picture, when meeting other vehicles you must move as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: When a vehicle comes towards you, moving to the right gives more side space between you. This avoids a head-on or side crash.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'incrociando' means meeting a vehicle coming the other way, not crossing a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Oncoming car: move close to the right edge
lines: A car comes the other way
Move close to the right edge

q22827.en: On a two-way carriageway with two lanes, as in the picture, vehicles must drive in the right lane, using the left one only for overtaking.

explain.short: With one lane each way, the left lane belongs to oncoming traffic. You use it only briefly to overtake.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'solo per il sorpasso' (only for overtaking) is correct: no other normal use of the left lane.

sceneParams.caption: Keep right; left lane only to overtake

q22828.en: On a two-way road with two lanes, as in the picture, vehicles driving up the uphill section of a hump (crest) must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: Going up a crest (dosso) you cannot see what comes from the other side. Keeping to the right avoids a head-on crash with a hidden vehicle.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'tratto in salita di un dosso' (uphill part of a crest): the view is blocked, so keep tight to the right.

sceneParams.caption: Uphill on a crest: keep tight to the right
lines: Crest ahead: you can't see beyond
Keep tight to the right edge

q22829.en: On a one-way road, vehicles going round a left-hand bend must keep close to the left edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: Even on a one-way road you keep to the right in bends. The left edge is used only to turn left into another road.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'curva a sinistra' is not 'svolta a sinistra': a bend is not a turn, so you still keep right.

sceneParams.caption: One-way, left bend: still keep right
lines: One-way road with a left bend
Do not cut to the left edge

q22830.en: On a road with two separate carriageways, as in the picture, vehicles going over a hump (crest) must keep close to the left edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: On a crest you must keep to the right, never to the left. The left side of your carriageway is for faster or overtaking traffic.
explain.rule: Keep as close as possible to the right edge in bends, on humps (dossi), when meeting oncoming vehicles, and always with bicycles, carts and animals.
explain.trap: 'margine sinistro' is wrong: on a crest you keep near the RIGHT edge.

sceneParams.caption: On a crest keep RIGHT, not left

q22831.en: Vehicles going round a bend, on a road with two lanes for each direction, as in the picture, may drive over the dashed line if the road is clear.

explain.short: In a bend you stay inside your lane and keep right. You must not drive over the lane line to cut the bend, even if the road looks clear.
explain.rule: In a bend keep to the right and stay inside your lane; never cut the bend by driving over the lane line.
explain.trap: 'se la strada è libera' (if the road is clear) does not allow cutting the bend.

sceneParams.caption: In a bend stay in your lane, don't cut it
lines: Stay in your lane, keep right
Don't cut over the dashed line

q22831.reviewNote: Official FALSE explained as: in a bend keep right in your lane (art. 143); the exact legal basis for not crossing a dashed line here is unclear.

q22832.en: Vehicles that want to turn left must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: For a left turn you move towards the centre line (or the left edge on a one-way road). Staying at the right edge would block traffic going straight.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'svolta a sinistra' + 'margine destro' do not match: the right edge is for RIGHT turns.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: near the centre line, not the right edge
lines: Move close to the centre line

q22833.en: Trolleybuses must, as a rule, drive as close as possible to the left edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: A trolleybus (filobus, an electric bus on overhead wires) is a road vehicle like any bus. It keeps to the right, not the left.
explain.rule: As a rule you drive on the right side of the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), near the right edge. The left lane is only for overtaking.
explain.trap: 'filobus' runs on tyres, not rails, so it follows the keep-right rule; 'margine sinistro' is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Trolleybuses keep RIGHT like other buses
lines: Trolleybus: a bus on electric wires
It drives like a normal bus
It keeps to the right edge

q22834.en: On roads with 2 lanes per direction, in heavy traffic, two-wheeled mopeds may drive in the left lane.

explain.short: Mopeds (ciclomotori, max 45 km/h) are slow, so they must use the right lane. Heavy traffic does not change this.
explain.rule: Mopeds must keep to the right lane on roads with several lanes; they leave it only to turn left.
explain.trap: 'in caso di intenso traffico' is the trap: heavy traffic gives no extra right to mopeds.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds stay in the right lane, even in traffic

q22835.en: On roads with 2 lanes per direction, in heavy traffic, mopeds may drive in the left lane.

explain.short: Mopeds (ciclomotori, max 45 km/h) are slow, so they must use the right lane. Heavy traffic does not change this.
explain.rule: Mopeds must keep to the right lane on roads with several lanes; they leave it only to turn left.
explain.trap: 'in caso di intenso traffico' is the trap: heavy traffic gives no extra right to mopeds.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds stay in the right lane, even in traffic

q22836.en: On a carriageway like the one in the picture, in heavy traffic, mopeds and motorcycles may drive on the cycle lane if they do not exceed 20 km/h.

explain.short: The yellow lanes with the bicycle symbol are cycle lanes (piste ciclabili), only for bicycles. Mopeds and motorcycles may never use them, at any speed.
explain.rule: A cycle lane is reserved for bicycles. Motor vehicles, mopeds included, may not use it, not even slowly or in heavy traffic.
explain.trap: 'se non superano la velocità di 20 km/h' is invented: no speed makes the cycle lane allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle lane: bicycles only, at any speed

q22837.en: In heavy traffic, motorcycles may drive on the emergency lanes.

explain.short: The emergency lane (corsia di emergenza) is for vehicles that break down and for rescue vehicles. Nobody may drive on it to skip a queue.
explain.rule: The emergency lane is only for stopping in an emergency and for rescue vehicles; normal traffic may never drive on it.
explain.trap: 'in caso di traffico intenso' does not give motorcycles any right to use the emergency lane.

sceneParams.caption: Emergency lane: never to skip a queue

q22838.en: When you want to change lane, you must not cause obstruction or danger to whoever is in the lane you are moving into.

explain.short: Changing lane must never force others to brake or swerve. If it would, wait.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'intralcio o pericolo' (obstruction or danger): both must be avoided.

sceneParams.caption: Change lane only if nobody must brake for you
lines: You want to move to the next lane
A car is coming in that lane

q22839.en: When you want to change lane, you must signal the manoeuvre in advance.

explain.short: Others need time to understand what you will do. So you switch on the indicator before you start moving, not while moving.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'in anticipo' (in advance) is the key: signalling at the last moment is not enough.

sceneParams.caption: Indicator first, then move

q22840.en: When you want to change lane, you must check that the lane you are moving into is clear ahead for a sufficient distance.

explain.short: If the new lane is blocked just ahead, you would have to brake or swerve back. Look ahead before you move.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'libera davanti per un tratto sufficiente' (clear ahead for enough distance): a free metre is not enough.

sceneParams.caption: Check the new lane is free far enough ahead
lines: It must be free for a good distance

q22841.en: When you want to change lane, you must check that the line dividing the lanes is dashed.

explain.short: You may cross a dashed (broken) line, but never a solid line. So check the line before changing lane.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'tratteggiata' (dashed) is right: a solid line (continua) must not be crossed.

sceneParams.caption: Dashed line: you may cross. Solid: never

q22842.en: When you want to change lane, you must signal the manoeuvre using the direction indicator.

explain.short: The indicator (freccia) tells everyone around you where you are going. It is required for every lane change.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'indicatore di direzione' means the indicator (blinker), not the horn or a hand sign.

sceneParams.caption: Every lane change: use the indicator

q22843.en: When you want to change lane, you must check that no other vehicles are coming in the lane you want to occupy.

explain.short: A car may be coming fast from behind in the other lane. Check the mirrors and the blind spot before moving.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'non stiano arrivando' (are not coming): you check behind too, not only ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Mirror check: nobody coming in the other lane
lines: Move only if nobody is coming

q22844.en: On urban roads it is allowed, when you want to turn, to drive straddling the lane lines.

explain.short: You must always drive inside one lane. Straddling two lanes (a cavallo) confuses others and blocks both lanes.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'a cavallo delle strisce' (straddling the lines) is forbidden everywhere, also in towns.

sceneParams.caption: Never drive straddling two lanes

q22845.en: When you want to change lane, using the direction indicator is optional if there are broken (dashed) lines.

explain.short: Dashed lines only mean you MAY cross them. You must still signal with the indicator every time.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'facoltativo' (optional) is the trap: the indicator is always required.

sceneParams.caption: Dashed line or not: indicator always

q22846.en: When you want to change lane, to move into the right-hand lane no particular care is needed.

explain.short: Moving right is a lane change like any other. A car, moped or bike may be in that lane, so check and signal.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'non occorre alcuna particolare attenzione' is wrong: every lane change needs care.

sceneParams.caption: Moving right also needs mirror and indicator
lines: You move into the right lane

q22847.en: Near junctions, as in the picture, you can always change lane up to the transverse stop line.

explain.short: Before a junction the lanes are divided by solid lines. From where the solid lines start, you may no longer change lane.
explain.rule: Near junctions, choose your lane early. Where the lane lines become solid, you must stay in your lane until the junction.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is the trap: solid lines before the stop line forbid changing lane.

sceneParams.caption: Solid lane lines: no more lane changes

q22848.en: When you want to change lane to overtake, it is compulsory to reduce speed.

explain.short: To overtake you usually need to go faster, not slower. The law only asks you to check, signal and not cause danger.
explain.rule: Before changing lane: check the mirrors, make sure the new lane is free ahead and behind, the line is dashed, and signal in advance with the indicator. You must not cause danger or get in anyone's way.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio ridurre la velocità' (must slow down) is invented: there is no such duty.

sceneParams.caption: Overtaking: check, signal, move - no need to slow down

q22849.en: When you want to change direction, you must switch on the direction indicator in advance.

explain.short: Others must know early that you will turn. So the indicator goes on before you slow down and turn.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'in anticipo' (in advance) is the key: not at the last moment.

sceneParams.caption: Indicator on early, before you turn

q22850.en: To turn left you must, as a rule, leave the centre of the junction on your right, like the vehicles in the picture.

explain.short: In the picture both cars turn left before reaching the centre point, so the centre stays on their right. This is the correct way.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'alla nostra destra' (on our right): you turn before the centre, not around it.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: the centre stays on your right
lines: The centre stays on your right

q22851.en: On a one-way road, to turn left you must keep to the left edge.

explain.short: On a one-way road nobody comes towards you. So for a left turn you move to the left edge, out of the way of the others.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' is the key: only on a one-way road do you go to the left edge.

sceneParams.caption: One-way road: turn left from the left edge
lines: Signal left, move to the left edge

q22852.en: While making a U-turn, the direction indicator must stay on for the whole manoeuvre.

explain.short: A U-turn (inversione di marcia) is slow and blocks the road. The indicator must stay on until it is finished, so others understand.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only where it is safe and not forbidden; you give way to everyone and keep the indicator on for the whole manoeuvre.
explain.trap: 'per l'intera durata' (for the whole time): not only at the start.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn: indicator on until the end
lines: Indicator on from start to end

q22853.en: The vehicle in the picture can turn right.

explain.short: The car is in the centre lane, between solid lines. It cannot move to the right lane now, so it cannot turn right.
explain.rule: Before a junction you must already be in the right lane for your direction: right lane to turn right, left lane to turn left. Solid lines forbid changing lane.
explain.trap: 'può svoltare a destra': the car's lane (the centre one) does not allow a right turn.

sceneParams.caption: Centre lane: it cannot turn right
lines: Right turn only from the right lane

q22854.en: To turn left you must go around the centre of the junction, like the vehicles in the picture.

explain.short: In the picture the cars drive around the centre point (centre on their left). That is the old way; today you turn before the centre, leaving it on your right.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'girare intorno al centro' (go around the centre) is the old, wrong way.

sceneParams.caption: Don't go around the centre: turn before it
lines: These cars go around the centre

keywords.en: go around the centre of the junction

q22855.en: When you want to change direction, it is compulsory to use sound signals (horn).

explain.short: You signal a turn with the indicator, not with the horn. The horn is only for real danger, and outside towns for warning.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio ... segnalazioni acustiche' is wrong: the horn is never required for a turn.

sceneParams.caption: Turns use the indicator, not the horn
lines: You want to turn at a junction

q22856.en: Driving on a half-carriageway with three lanes, as in the picture, to turn left you must use the central lane.

explain.short: With three lanes in your direction, you turn left from the left lane. The central lane is usually for going straight.
explain.rule: On a road with several lanes in your direction, turn left from the left lane and right from the right lane; choose the lane early.
explain.trap: 'corsia centrale' is wrong for a left turn: you use the LEFT lane.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: from the left lane, not the centre
lines: Left turn: use the left lane

q22857.en: On a two-way road, to turn left you must not enter the road you are turning into on the wrong side.

explain.short: If you cut the corner, you end up on the left side of the new road, against oncoming traffic. Turn wide enough to land on its right side.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'contromano' (on the wrong side) is exactly what you must avoid.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: don't cut the corner into the wrong side
lines: Enter the new road on its right side

q22858.en: On a two-way road, when turning left you must, as a rule, leave the centre of the junction on your right, like the vehicles in the picture.

explain.short: The cars in the picture turn left before the centre point, which stays on their right. This is the correct left turn.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'alla nostra destra' (on our right): you pass to the left of the centre point.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: the centre stays on your right
lines: The centre stays on your right

q22859.en: On a two-way road, to turn left you must move into the lanes that allow you to continue in that direction.

explain.short: If lanes have arrows, you must use the lane for left turns. You choose it early, before the solid lines.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'corsie che consentono di proseguire' means the lanes marked for that direction.

sceneParams.caption: Use the lane marked for left turns
lines: Pick the lane for left turns

q22860.en: On a two-way road, to turn left you must move to the left of the solid centre line.

explain.short: A solid centre line must not be crossed or driven over to wait. You stay on your side, close to it, and turn at the junction.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'a sinistra della linea continua' would put you in the oncoming lane: wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Stay right of the centre line, close to it
lines: Two-way road with a solid centre line
Don't cross it before the junction
Wait close to it on your side

q22861.en: On a two-way road, to turn left you must keep along the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: For a left turn you move close to the centre line. From the right edge you would cut across traffic going straight.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' is for right turns, not left turns.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: near the centre line, not the right edge
lines: Move close to the centre line

q22862.en: On a two-way road, to turn left you must stop before completing the manoeuvre, even if no vehicles are coming.

explain.short: You stop only if you must give way to oncoming vehicles or pedestrians. If nobody is coming, you can turn without stopping.
explain.rule: On a two-way road, to turn left move close to the centre line (mezzeria) on your own side, use the lanes for left turns, and turn just before the centre of the junction (centre on your right). Do not enter the new road on the wrong side.
explain.trap: 'anche se non sopraggiungono veicoli' is the trap: with nobody coming, no stop is needed.

sceneParams.caption: Nobody coming? Turn left without stopping
lines: No need to stop: just turn

q22863.en: Driving on a one-way carriageway, a left turn is made by signalling the manoeuvre in advance.

explain.short: Every turn must be signalled early with the indicator, also on a one-way road. Then you move to the left edge and turn.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'in anticipo' (in advance) is the key word and it is correct.

sceneParams.caption: One-way: signal early, then turn left

q22864.en: While driving in parallel rows, it is allowed to change lane to make turning manoeuvres.

explain.short: In parallel rows you normally stay in your lane. Changing lane is allowed when you need to get to the lane for your turn, with care and signalling.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'per effettuare manovre di svolta' (to turn) is the allowed reason for changing lane.

sceneParams.caption: Parallel rows: change lane only to reach your turn
lines: You need the left lane to turn

q22865.en: Driving in parallel rows is allowed when authorised by traffic officers.

explain.short: Traffic officers can direct traffic as they decide. If they allow parallel rows, you may drive side by side.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'autorizzata dagli agenti' (allowed by officers) is one of the cases where it is permitted.

sceneParams.caption: Officer allows it: parallel rows OK
lines: You may drive in parallel rows

q22866.en: Driving in parallel rows is allowed on roads with two lanes per direction at a junction regulated by traffic lights.

explain.short: Two lanes in your direction and a traffic-light junction: both conditions for parallel rows are met.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'due corsie per senso' + 'regolato da semaforo': both conditions are there.

sceneParams.caption: Two lanes each way + traffic lights: rows OK

keywords.it: due corsie per senso di marcia

q22867.en: On roads with at least two lanes per direction, as in the picture, when traffic is heavy, you can drive in parallel rows.

explain.short: With two lanes each way and heavy traffic, the lanes fill up. Driving side by side is then allowed.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'qualora il traffico sia intenso' (when traffic is heavy) is the condition that makes it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: 2+ lanes each way, heavy traffic: rows OK
lines: Heavy traffic: side by side OK

keywords.it: almeno due corsie per senso di marcia
keywords.en: at least two lanes per direction

q22868.en: As a rule, it is allowed to drive in parallel rows along the stretch of road leading to a junction regulated by traffic officers.

explain.short: Near a junction directed by officers, queues form in every lane. So parallel rows are allowed on the approach.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'regolato da agenti del traffico' (directed by officers) is what makes it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Approach to a police-run junction: rows OK
lines: Junction ahead run by an officer

q22869.en: In heavy traffic on a one-way carriageway with three lanes, as in the picture, it is allowed to drive in parallel rows.

explain.short: On a one-way road all three lanes go your way. With heavy traffic, driving side by side is allowed.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' is the key: here three lanes all go in your direction.

sceneParams.caption: One-way, 3 lanes, heavy traffic: rows OK
lines: Heavy traffic: side by side OK

q22870.en: Driving on a one-way carriageway, a left turn is made by moving into any lane, if you are driving in parallel rows.

explain.short: Even in parallel rows, you turn left from the left lane (left edge). Turning from any lane would cut across other cars.
explain.rule: To change direction, signal in advance with the indicator. Turn right from the right edge; turn left from near the centre line (on a one-way road from the left edge), passing with the centre of the junction on your right.
explain.trap: 'una corsia qualsiasi' (any lane) is the trap: only the left lane is right.

sceneParams.caption: One-way: turn left only from the left lane
lines: Left turn from the left lane

q22871.en: It is allowed to drive in parallel rows along the stretch of road leading to a junction NOT regulated by traffic lights or traffic officers.

explain.short: Parallel rows near a junction are allowed only with traffic lights or officers. At an unregulated junction the side-by-side cars would hide each other.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'non regolato' (NOT regulated): the little word 'non' makes it false.

sceneParams.caption: No lights, no officer: no parallel rows
lines: Rows side by side hide each other

q22872.en: It is allowed to drive in parallel rows on a road with two lanes and two-way traffic, like the one in the picture.

explain.short: This road has only one lane for each direction. Driving side by side would use the oncoming lane.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'due corsie e doppio senso': one lane per direction, so no parallel rows.

sceneParams.caption: One lane each way: no parallel rows
lines: No room to drive side by side

q22873.en: It is ALWAYS allowed to drive in parallel rows if the two-way carriageway has at least two lanes for each direction, like the one in the picture.

explain.short: Two lanes each way is needed, but it is not enough by itself. You also need heavy traffic, a regulated junction, or officers' permission.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is the trap: parallel rows need a reason like heavy traffic.

sceneParams.caption: Two lanes each way is not enough: not ALWAYS

q22874.en: In built-up areas it is allowed to drive in parallel rows in any traffic condition.

explain.short: Being in a town does not change the rule. Parallel rows need two or more lanes in your direction and a reason, like heavy traffic.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'in qualunque condizione di traffico' (in any traffic) is the trap: the conditions still apply in town.

sceneParams.caption: In town too: rows only with heavy traffic

q22875.en: It is compulsory to drive in parallel rows on carriageways with three lanes per direction, like the one in the picture.

explain.short: Parallel rows are allowed in some cases, never compulsory. Normally you use the freest lane on the right.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory) is the trap: it is only allowed, not required.

sceneParams.caption: Parallel rows: allowed sometimes, never compulsory
lines: Normally: freest lane on the right

keywords.it: tre corsie per senso di marcia

q22876.en: While driving in parallel rows, when using the left lane you must keep the left direction indicator on.

explain.short: The indicator is only for announcing a manoeuvre. Leaving it on while you drive straight would confuse others.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'mantenere in funzione' (keep on) is wrong: the indicator goes off after the manoeuvre.

sceneParams.caption: Driving straight in the left lane: indicator off
lines: Parallel rows, you are in the left lane

q22877.en: Driving in parallel rows is not allowed if the road has only one carriageway.

explain.short: What matters is the number of lanes in your direction, not the number of carriageways. One carriageway with two lanes each way can allow parallel rows.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'una sola carreggiata' (one carriageway) is not the condition: lanes per direction are.

sceneParams.caption: One carriageway with 2+ lanes each way: rows OK
lines: One carriageway, two lanes each way

q22878.en: While driving in parallel rows, motorcycles may move forward by passing between the vehicles side by side.

explain.short: Riding between two rows of cars is dangerous: a car may change lane or open a door. It is not allowed.
explain.rule: Driving in parallel rows (file parallele, side by side in several lanes) is allowed only with 2+ lanes per direction or a one-way road with 2+ lanes, when traffic is heavy, near junctions with traffic lights or police, or when traffic officers allow it.
explain.trap: 'passando tra i veicoli affiancati' (between the side-by-side cars) is not allowed for anyone.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles don't squeeze between the rows
lines: Not allowed: stay in the row

q22879.en: At junctions it is compulsory to give way to vehicles running on rails (trams and trains), unless signs say otherwise.

explain.short: Trams and trains cannot swerve and need a long distance to stop. So at junctions they have priority, unless signs say something different.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise) is correct: signs can change it.

sceneParams.caption: Tram at the junction: let it pass

q22880.en: It is compulsory to give way to the right and to the left when you join traffic from a standstill.

explain.short: When you pull out from a parked or stopped position, the moving traffic has priority. You check both sides and wait.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'da fermi' (from a standstill): you give way to traffic from BOTH sides.

sceneParams.caption: Pulling out from a stop: give way both sides
lines: You start from a parked position
Wait until the road is clear

keywords.it: precedenza a destra e a sinistra

q22881.en: It is compulsory to give way to all vehicles on the road when making a U-turn.

explain.short: A U-turn crosses all the lanes and is slow. Everybody else has priority while you do it.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' (to all vehicles) is correct for a U-turn.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn: give way to everyone
lines: You want to make a U-turn
Give way to all, then turn

q22882.en: It is compulsory to give way to all vehicles when reversing.

explain.short: When reversing you see badly and others do not expect you. So all other vehicles have priority.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' (to all vehicles) is correct for reversing.

sceneParams.caption: Reversing: give way to everyone
lines: You reverse out of a space
Look in the mirrors and behind

q22883.en: It is compulsory to give way to the right and to the left when coming out of a driveway.

explain.short: A driveway (passo carrabile) comes from private property. Cars on the road have priority from both sides.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'passo carrabile' means a driveway or garage exit: you give way both ways.

sceneParams.caption: Out of a driveway: give way both sides

keywords.it: precedenza a destra e a sinistra

q22884.en: It is compulsory to give way to the right and to the left in the presence of the sign in the picture.

explain.short: This is the STOP sign. You must stop at the line and give way to traffic from both sides.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: The sign is 'STOP': stop always, then give way to the right and the left.

sceneParams.caption: STOP: stop, then give way right and left

keywords.it: precedenza a destra e a sinistra

q22885.en: It is compulsory to give way to the right and to the left in the presence of the sign in the picture.

explain.short: This sign warns of a junction with priority to the right (incrocio con precedenza a destra). You give way only to vehicles from your right.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' is too much: this sign means give way only to the RIGHT.

sceneParams.caption: This sign: give way only to the RIGHT

keywords.it: precedenza a destra e a sinistra

q22886.en: It is compulsory to give way to the right and to the left in the presence of the ROUNDABOUT sign.

explain.short: The roundabout sign (rotatoria, blue with three arrows) only tells you to drive around anticlockwise. Who gives way is shown by another sign, usually the give-way triangle: then you give way to traffic already on the roundabout, from your left.
explain.rule: At a roundabout you go anticlockwise. Normally a give-way sign tells you to give way to vehicles already on the roundabout, which come from your left.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' is wrong: the roundabout sign itself does not order this.

sceneParams.caption: Roundabout sign: drive round, not give way both sides
lines: Give-way sign: yield to cars on it

keywords.it: precedenza a destra e a sinistra

q22887.en: It is compulsory to give way to all vehicles at junctions regulated by a traffic light with a flashing yellow light.

explain.short: A flashing yellow light means 'take care': the light is not regulating. You use the normal priority rules, usually give way to the right.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' is too much: with flashing yellow normal rules apply, not give way to all.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: normal rules, give way to the right
lines: Junction with a flashing yellow light
Normal rule: give way to the right

q22888.en: It is compulsory to give way to all vehicles on the road when turning left.

explain.short: When turning left you give way to oncoming traffic and to those who have priority by the normal rules. Not to absolutely everyone.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' is too much: a left turn is not a U-turn or reversing.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn: give way to oncoming, not to everyone

q22889.en: It is compulsory to give way to all vehicles on the road in the presence of the sign in the picture.

explain.short: This sign announces a junction where YOU have priority (intersezione con diritto di precedenza). The side roads must give way to you.
explain.rule: You give way to everyone when you join traffic from a stop or a driveway, reverse or make a U-turn, and at a STOP sign. At junctions you give way to trams and trains, and as a rule to vehicles from the right.
explain.trap: 'dare la precedenza a tutti' is the opposite: this sign gives YOU the priority.

sceneParams.caption: This sign: YOU have priority over side roads
